Indigenous Leaders Seek Health Care Changes After Childbirth Death

Indigenous leaders in Saskatchewan are calling for changes to health care following the death of a woman during childbirth. The incident has also prompted discussions and potential legislative changes regarding families' control over a deceased person's body, as highlighted by the family's experience after the woman, identified as Caitlin, died.
